meta.day_index: day of year 1-365 (31 Dec of leap years folded onto day 365)

sea_ice_extent.title: Daily Antarctic sea-ice extent (concentration ≥ 15 %)
sea_ice_extent.source: EUMETSAT OSI SAF OSI-450-a CDR + OSI-430-a ICDR via Copernicus Marine (C1)
sea_ice_extent.note: Days with missing swaths are omitted. Before 1987 the SMMR record is every other day.

t2m.title: Daily Antarctic-mean 2 m air temperature (60–90° S, area-weighted)
t2m.note: Daily ERA5 on disk starts in 2014, so the reference envelope uses 2014–2025 (short baseline).
